verdict.rationale: Bugbot findings include inline comments with suggested fixes, and 'Fix in Cursor' / 'Fix in Web' links hand off issues directly into Cursor IDE or cursor.com/agents for one-click fixing — a genuine direct-integration handoff, corroborated by community reports of fixes being applied from its suggestions. However, there is no evidence of explicit copyable fix-prompt export or direct integration with Claude Code or Codex — only Cursor's own agent surfaces are supported. Missing for 10: copyable/portable fix prompts for external agents, documented Claude Code integration, documented Codex integration.
